correctness.rationale: The self-contained enumeration reconstructs all 752 matching faces from 18 explicit edges. The exact 369-pair Morse matching leaves one 0-simplex and twelve 3-simplices; checking all 2502 oriented incidences proves acyclicity, so Forman discrete Morse yields the integral wedge of twelve three-spheres. The degree-based automorphism construction accounts for all 12 graph symmetries, and signed Lefschetz traces (12,0,-3,-2,2,1) give exact rational S3xC2 multiplicities 1,0,0,1,2,3. Reexecuted Python verification reproduces all counts. No infinite extrapolation.
